how.title: How we calculate
how.lede: The calculator uses Bizkaia's tax rules (Norma Foral 13/2013), not the rules for the rest of Spain. Every value has a source and the date it was checked.
how.coversList: Bizkaia IRPF: 23–49 % scale, 20/15/10 % reduction, new autónomo reduction, €1,615 minoración, children and rent deductions, EPSV.
Bizkaia modelo 130: 20 % per quarter in the first two years; from the third, 5 % of net income from two years earlier.
RETA: tarifa plana, 15 income bands, extension, regularisation.
IVA: quarterly 303 and annual 390 (no Q4 303 in Bizkaia).
Salary from a job: contributions, allowance, Bizkaia withholding table, refund of excess contributions.
Social security (RETA) is based on profit after the 20 / 15 / 10 % reduction (Gure Gida, Id 4014).
Modelo 130 doesn't apply the 20 / 15 / 10 % reduction: the prepayment is worked out from income minus expenses (RIRPF Bizkaia, art. 110.1.a).
The 20 / 15 / 10 % reduction doesn't apply to a loss.
how.notList: Estimación directa normal, retail, recargo de equivalencia.
IVA-exempt activities and OSS for sales to EU consumers.
Income in other currencies: enter the euro amount from your invoice.
how.openLede: There's no official text for these values yet. We use the closest source and mark the result as a guide.
